koynx.title: KOYNX
koynx.seoTitle: KOYNX: fintech savings app with Esusu and stokvel
koynx.desc: Three surfaces (mobile, web and admin) designed end to end on one design system. Every money-moving flow passed compliance review with zero redesign…

koynx-admin.title: KOYNX Admin
koynx-admin.seoTitle: KOYNX Admin: fintech admin dashboard and KYC design
koynx-admin.desc: One portal for every operations job: KYC in three tiers, risk ranked by severity, and role-based access, with every action logged by IP and timestamp.

hillcross-college-website.title: HillCross College Website
hillcross-college-website.seoTitle: HillCross College website: admissions hero redesign
hillcross-college-website.desc: The intake year is now visible as soon as the page loads. Admissions entry points above the fold went from 2 to 4, and hero copy dropped from 63 words to 8.

hillcross-student-dashboard.title: HillCross College Student Dashboard
hillcross-student-dashboard.seoTitle: HillCross student dashboard: edtech UX redesign
hillcross-student-dashboard.desc: One dashboard that always shows a student their next step, from Start Registration to their first module, with support on every view.

hillcross-teacher-dashboard.title: HillCross College Teacher Dashboard
hillcross-teacher-dashboard.seoTitle: HillCross teacher dashboard: edtech LMS redesign
hillcross-teacher-dashboard.desc: Signing in now answers three questions on one screen: how the class is doing, what needs grading and what has changed.

hillcross-university-student-portal.title: HillCross University Student Portal
hillcross-university-student-portal.seoTitle: HillCross University student portal: edtech web app with AI study planning
hillcross-university-student-portal.desc: 13 student flows designed end to end, from first application to exam day, on one design system that the lecturer and admin portals will share.

wemove-fitness.title: WeMove Fitness
wemove-fitness.seoTitle: WeMove Fitness: gamified fitness app UI/UX
wemove-fitness.desc: A seven-step onboarding that ends in the first reward, and a collectible mint system that testers said gave them a reason not to skip a day.

lucenture-consult.title: Lucenture Consult
lucenture-consult.seoTitle: Lucenture Consult: brand identity and website for a Nigerian consultancy
lucenture-consult.desc: A live four-page site with a booking flow, where Book a call is always within reach and every service says who it's for.

heatbud.title: HeatBud
heatbud.seoTitle: HeatBud: heat safety app for Nigeria, designed and built
heatbud.desc: Live and installable at heatbud.netlify.app: feels-like temperature, a seven-day heat forecast, a personal water plan and three ways to be reminded.

blissbill.title: BlissBill
blissbill.seoTitle: BlissBill: Nigerian bill payment fintech app design
blissbill.desc: Seven flows designed end to end in light and dark mode, from sign-up and identity checks to bill payments and a virtual card.

laundromate.title: Laundromate
laundromate.seoTitle: Laundromate: on-demand laundry app UX for African cities
laundromate.desc: A complete booking app with 8 flows. Prices show in local currency before sign-up, and the receipt matches the review screen line for line.
